apex_rule: high_estimate_usd >= 500000; where blank, price_usd of a lot sold with a price
mai_formula: MAI = sum of P / number of events with apex lots: the mean of P over every event with apex lots, 0 where the make had none, so MAIs add up to 1. P = share of the event's apex lots. Events count equally. Q (mean price / high estimate over apex lots sold with a price and an estimate) and R (sold / (sold + not sold)) are reported beside the score, not multiplied in. Withdrawn lots excluded; apex_unknown lots excluded and counted.
